name: OHNOO
title: The psychic panic
description: A turtle spirit sees disaster coming, overloads with cyan energy, then flops into a daze.

name: COPIUM
title: A very large sip
description: A ram processes the loss, finds a glowing blue bottle, takes a huge sip and rallies.

name: YEP
title: Approved by fire
description: A phoenix nods, drops its shades, points at chat and seals it with a fiery approval.

name: BONK
title: The bonk finds you
description: A bear sees a giant foam mallet too late, gets bonked, spins out and shrugs it off.

name: SLEEPY
title: Queue nap
description: A turtle slows down, conjures a star pillow, curls up in its shell, then jolts awake.

name: HYPE
title: Full send
description: A thunder ram charges up, breaks out glowsticks, swings them and lands a lightning hype pose.
